Container.Name: Chorely
Container.Overview: Chorely — a family chore and allowance tracker. Parents approve chore completions, kids earn per-chore money plus a weekly bonus. Kids tap their profile and go, parents use a 4-digit PIN.
Container.Description: Chorely is a self-hosted family chore tracker. Features: - Profile-based login (kids tap to enter, parents use 4-digit PIN) - One-tap chore completion with parent approval queue - Per-chore payouts plus weekly bonus when all chores are done - Weekly history and 4-week earnings chart per kid - Works on iPhone, iPad, and computer (responsive web) - All data stored in SQLite in the mapped appdata folder Default parent PINs are 1234 — change them in the Manage tab after first login.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port to access Chorely (3000 is already used by kasm on this server)
